FN-VB64PL-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 256
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Tim Melson
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 05/02/2023
Senate Bill 256 as reported by the Committee on County and Municipal Government would
authorize certain county commissions with an agricultural authority incorporated prior to
September 1, 2017, to reallocate 70% of TVA in-lieu of taxes payments received by the county
commission to the agricultural authority, subject to approval by majority vote of the local
legislative delegation. This bill will not directly affect state or local funding.

FN-VB64PL-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 256
Committee: Agriculture and Forestry Sponsor: Senator Tim Melson
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 05/09/2023
Senate Bill 256 as passed the Senate would require county commissions with an agricultural
authority incorporated prior to September 1, 2017 to reallocate 70% of TVA in-lieu-of tax
payments received by the county commission to the agricultural authority, subject to approval by
majority vote of the local legislative delegation residing in the county. This bill would not
otherwise affect state or local funding.
Only Lauderdale County meets the criteria of this bill, which would redistribute an estimated
$3.1 million in TVA in-lieu of-tax payments annually from the Lauderdale County
Commission to the Lauderdale County Agriculture Center Authority, subject to approval of the
local legislative delegation residing in Lauderdale County.
